items.title: The Bull Case For Old Dominion Freight Line (ODFL) Could Change Following Its October LTL Rate Increase
items.summary: Old Dominion Freight Line recently implemented a 4.9% general rate increase on select LTL and related tariffs to help offset cost pressures and fund investments in real estate, equipment, technology, and competitive wages. The rate move, combined with upward earnings estimate revisions and a favorable Zacks Rank, highlights how pricing power and analyst expectations are shaping perceptions of Old Dominion’s operating strength. items.title: Diesel at $6 Just Ate J.B. Hunt’s Quarter. Truckers Can’t Raise Prices Fast Enough
items.summary: Diesel just delivered J.B. Hunt its worst single-day drop in recent memory, yet Wall Street still sees shares climbing more than 25% from here. The question is whether management can close the gap between surging costs and lagging fuel surcharges before investors lose patience.

items.title: Old Dominion pulls forward 4.9% GRI as LTL carriers accelerate rate hikes
items.summary: Old Dominion Freight Line announced Monday a 4.9% general rate increase across various tariff codes effective Oct. 5, moving the date up by a month for the second consecutive year. The post Old Dominion pulls forward 4.9% GRI as LTL carriers accelerate rate hikes appeared first on FreightWaves.

items.title: Old Dominion announces 4.9% general rate increase
items.summary: The increase, which applies to a selection of services, is effective Oct. 5.

items.title: Old Dominion (ODFL) Loses 16.2% in 4 Weeks, Here's Why a Trend Reversal May be Around the Corner
items.summary: The heavy selling pressure might have exhausted for Old Dominion (ODFL) as it is technically in oversold territory now. In addition to this technical measure, strong agreement among Wall Street analysts in revising earnings estimates higher indicates that the stock is ripe for a trend reversal.

items.title: J.B. Hunt's Stock Plunges After Market Misprices Profit Warning
items.summary: J.B. Hunt warned of higher driver-related costs, sending shares down, but analysts trimmed price targets while raising others, keeping a Moderate Buy rating amid sector-wide trucking pressure.

items.title: J.B. Hunt Stock Down 13% in Yesterday's Trading: Here's Why
items.summary: JBHT's shares fall after management has warned that rising driver, fuel and claims costs could pressure Q3 earnings despite strong demand.
